card.name: Inside brand names and St. John's
card.fires_on: Partway through capitalized brand drug names (KATERZIA, LIBTAYO, DANYELZA), the 's in St. John's wort, and the odd word that continues a name or phrase.

modes.label: Brand name interior
modes.description: A middle piece of an uppercase brand name or a long drug name.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue D<<ANY>>ELZA based on severity

modes.label: St. John's wort
modes.description: The 's after St. John in interaction lists.
modes.example: Inducers of CYP3A4 such as St. John<<'s>> wort (Hypericum perforatum)

modes.label: Other mid-phrase words
modes.description: A noun that continues a phrase, such as replacement or Therapy.
modes.example: As with the use of other<< replacement>> solutions

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed and the suppressed ones are name endings like brand, um and amine.
card.plain: It fires inside drug brand names and on the 's of St. John's wort, where the name is not yet finished.
